ancillary_scope.reason: Optional unfiltered raw controls narrowed after k18/c1/r2.55 required 700.778 search seconds and overflowed 196322/196596 indices; matched re-pooled versus separate assigned-read controls remain required and continue
ancillary_scope.incomplete_settings: Not counted as zero; complete diagnostic files are retained as ancillary measured results

design_assistance: Full design sequences are used to assign reads to blocks; reads are not corrected, filled, or converted to reference sequences
metrics: Candidate unions and output unions are truth-labelled coverage; each decision output is chosen without truth before scoring
fair_partition_control: assigned_pooled versus broad/common10 uses the exact same aligned/filtered read population, joined versus separate

full_sequence_quality_audit.method: SHA-256 per (read name, original sequence, original quality), zero-delimited; order-independent four-limb sums and XORs plus read/base totals
full_sequence_quality_audit.scope: Broad blocks plus ambiguous and unassigned form a complete disjoint read multiset; strict/inclusive are overlapping subsets

assigned_pool_audit.note: The re-pooled control and the twelve separate broad files contain the same full read-name/sequence/quality multiset; all concatenated gzip members were read
